name: kettlebell one arm swing
description: A one-armed kettlebell swing driven by the hips. It builds the posterior chain and conditioning.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders and hold a kettlebell with one hand.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and let the bell float up to chest height.
Keep your arm relaxed and your back flat.
Let the bell fall back and hinge again, then switch hands after your reps.
